title: Console: style Markus classes + preview chrome only
description:
Console CSS for Markus class names plus light preview chrome only. No redesign of wiki chrome beyond what is needed to show Markus output correctly. The browser must not parse :::directives.

Requested card id kbs-82fcbb was not present on this develop board; this task continues that work.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
In progress on https://github.com/AnthusAI/Kanbus/pull/226

Console wiki preview consumes backend `rendered_html` (no client-side `:::directive` parsing). Added Markus class styles (`markus-document`, `markus-pull-quote`, `markus-card-grid`, `markus-card`, and related) plus light preview chrome. Do not close until #226 merges. Requested id kbs-82fcbb was not on this board snapshot.
